title: AutoClip-DPZO: Practical Private Clipping Selection for Differentially Private Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Differentially private zeroth-order optimization (DPZO) is a promising approach for privacy-preserving LLM fine-tuning, offering exceptional memory efficiency. However, its utility is highly sensitive to the clipping threshold $C$, a key DP-specific hyperparameter that controls the trade-off between noise injection and clipping bias. Existing DPZO methods typically tune $C$ by repeatedly evaluating candidate values and reporting the best result, which is computationally expensive and incurs additional privacy cost that must be accounted for under DP. Designing a practical DP procedure for selecting $C$ in DPZO is challenging because no fixed choice performs well across settings, straightforward search-based strategies suffer from poor utility and efficiency, and existing clipping-selection methods for DPSGD do not transfer well to DPZO due to its fundamentally different error regime. translated_abstract: 差分隐私零阶优化（DPZO）是一种很有前景的隐私保护LLM微调方法，具有出色的内存效率。然而，其效用对剪裁阈值 $C$ 高度敏感，这是一个关键的DP特有超参数，用于控制噪声注入与剪裁偏差之间的权衡。现有的DPZO方法通常通过反复评估候选值并报告最佳结果来调整 $C$，这在计算上代价高昂，并且会产生额外的隐私成本，必须在DP框架下予以考虑。为DPZO设计一个实用的选择 $C$ 的DP流程极具挑战性，原因在于：没有任何固定取值能在所有设置下都表现良好，直接的基于搜索的策略效用和效率较差，而且现有的DPSGD剪裁选择方法由于其根本不同的误差机制而无法很好地迁移到DPZO。在本文中，我们提出了AutoClip-DPZO，一个实用的……
tldr: 提出AutoClip-DPZO，一种用于差分隐私零阶LLM微调的实用剪裁阈值自动选择方法，无需反复搜索调参即可自动确定剪裁阈值，避免额外计算开销与隐私成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes AutoClip-DPZO, a practical method for automatically selecting the clipping threshold in differentially private zeroth-order LLM fine-tuning, eliminating the need for costly repeated tuning and the associated extra privacy costs.
